integration_notes: Add pub mod blast_dynamic_align to src/core/mod.rs. Worker changed no shared files.

BlastDynamicAlign borrows ordinary matrix rows and optional PSSM rows; it owns dynamic DP cells and pooled traceback states plus source output fields. It can be initialized with matrix/gap_x_dropoff and ..Default::default(); preexisting DP storage/count may also be supplied consistently.

DynamicSequence {data,offset} is an explicit signed pointer-origin binding. For a normal query buffer with a leading sentinel use offset1; packed subject base storage normally uses offset0. Original positive/negative relative anchor reads must be within data. Kernels deliberately do not copy/repack the source slices.

s_blast_dyn_prog_nt_gapped_alignment uses existing BlastInitHSP (required ungapped_data) and BlastScoringParameters gap_open/gap_extend. Its output fields are the preliminary gapped score and query/subject start/stop.

Generic Blast_SemiGappedAlign/ALIGN_EX retain optional position-based/PSSM selection but default nucleotide/protein ordinary-matrix paths were the focus. Full left/right final-traceback orchestration, script composition, HSP pruning and result statistics are still parent integration work.
